artifact_observations.location: Pink bird decorations on top of the cupcake
artifact_observations.reasoning: The pink 'birds' are structurally nonsensical. They appear to be melting into the frosting, lack defined anatomy (legs, clear heads), and some seem to fuse with each other or the frosting in a physically impossible way. They look like AI-hallucinated hybrids of petals and birds.
The frosting has an overly smooth, plastic-like sheen that lacks the typical micro-texture of buttercream or whipped cream. It looks more like rendered 3D geometry than edible food.
The fluting of the paper liner becomes irregular and slightly warped near the bottom right, losing consistent perspective lines.
